answer: Here is one mechanism that works: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because nadir only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, signal is enforced in the ledger: The ledger rejects byte-identical submissions, forcing each clone to generate distinct work. Any tide approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
